title: Elf Bar 600 Spearmint Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Compatible with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods provide a hassle-free way to enjoy outstanding flavour and satisfaction without the waste and expense caused by single-use disposables. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying draw and fast nicotine relief. Spearmint Flavour: A crisp and refreshing spearmint flavour that offers a cool, subtly sweet inhale with a smooth, soothing finish. Light yet satisfying, this flavour provides a clean and revitalising vape experience. Swapping pods is effortless—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're moving away from disposables or looking for a convenient, flavour-packed alternative, these prefilled pods deliver the same great performance that Elf Bar is known for.
